title: Garren's Haunt

[[image:Garren's Haunt.jpg|thumb|Garren's Haunt]]
'''Garren's Haunt''' is a large farmstead in northern [[Tirisfal Glades]], comprised of a farmhouse, a barn, a couple of silos, and a widestretched field. Although this was a bountiful place before the [[Plague of Undeath]], it now lies gray and lifeless. Garren and his family were brutally murdered by the [[Scourge]] during the [[Third War]], and his home is now residence to a host of undead [[gnoll]]s who hungrily attack anyone who comes too close.
